items.title: Report explores how Roblox can maintain older players as it becomes most-played game by total hours in H1 2026
items.zh_title: 报告：Roblox 上半年总游玩时长登顶，探讨如何留住年长玩家
items.summary: Roblox generated 4.05 billion hours of playtime across PC and console in H1 2026, making it the most-played game by total hours. Read more
items.zh_summary: 2026 年上半年，Roblox 在 PC 和主机端累计产生 40.5 亿小时游玩时长，按总时长算已成为游玩人数最多的游戏。

items.title: Fortnite returns to iOS in Australia after court rules Apple violated competition law
items.zh_title: 法院裁定 Apple 违反竞争法，《Fortnite》重返澳大利亚 iOS
items.summary: Fortnite is returning to iOS in Australia after a court decision ruled that Apple must open iOS to third-party app stores after finding it violated competition law. Read more
items.zh_summary: 法院裁定 Apple 违反竞争法、必须向第三方应用商店开放 iOS 后，《Fortnite》将重返澳大利亚 iOS 平台。

items.title: Meeting you where you work: Inside 200M+ Unity CLI events

items.title: Skipping domain reload: faster iteration using the MethodReload feature
items.zh_title: 跳过 Domain Reload：用 MethodReload 功能加快迭代
items.summary: Stop waiting on domain reloads! Learn how MethodReload speeds up Unity iteration time, explore its limitations, and compare it to existing hot reload tools.
items.zh_summary: 别再等 Domain Reload 了，本文介绍 MethodReload 如何加快 Unity 的迭代速度，讲清它的局限，并和现有的热重载工具做对比。

items.title: Level design basics: Guiding players without telling them

items.title: EA closes Mass Effect, Dragon Age creator BioWare after 30 years of game development
items.zh_title: EA 关闭《Mass Effect》《Dragon Age》开发商 BioWare，30 年历史落幕

items.zh_summary: 据报道 EA 将裁员 400 人，其中 50 人是 BioWare 仅剩的员工。

items.title: BioWare is closing after 30 years
items.zh_title: BioWare 关闭，30 年历史落幕
items.summary: Mass Effect and Dragon Age developer BioWare is closing after more than 30 years, and early development on the next Mass Effect project is ending. Read more
items.zh_summary: 《Mass Effect》和《Dragon Age》开发商 BioWare 在运营 30 多年后关闭，下一部《Mass Effect》的前期开发也随之终止。
